title: KAITO — A Cheshire Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day of the Project Wonder show
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that's everyone, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even all the flowers decided to gather for this♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I didn't expect the plushies and flowers to gather like this considering how little time we have to prepare.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It is an opportunity to be in a special show that's bound to be a big hit, right? Who wouldn't want to join in on that♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! So when are we supposed to appear?
When are they actually going to do this show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Patience, Len. I understand that you're excited, but we still need to do some final checks to make sure we all know what we're supposed to do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This show, Project Wonder... It's meant to be a monumental spectacle that can protect the hopes, dreams and smiles of so many people.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why our part, Smiling Nighttime, has to go just as well as the main part of the show! We're giving it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's perfect!
You have some time to rest now before the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO☆ Are the flowers done rehearsing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. How about your team, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. We're all set too♪
Never underestimate the great Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Wonderful!
Alright, why don't we go see how the other teams are doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, there's Team Kagamine.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so cool☆
They're all in perfect sync♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's very impressive!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm glad Rin's enjoying herself too.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She'd gotten to know Nene and Emu more lately, and seemed to be working a little harder than I would've hoped to cheer Emu up...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's no need to worry now, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. She has Len and the plushies with her too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO, look!
It's MEIKO and Luka!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They'll be performing a song with the flowers, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since it's MEIKO and Luka leading things here, I'm sure there won't be any cause for... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh oh. Luka's asleep...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I can see that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Hello, KAITO! Miku!
Here to check up on us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well... How are things going for your team?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Perfect♪ The flowers are doing great!
Luka said she'll be at 100% for the real thing and wants to get some rest in now...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting extra sleep whenever she can, huh....

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry♪ She might look like a sleepyhead, but she's been so excited all day!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let me prove it to you...
Flowers! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Lalala♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! She can sing while she sleeps?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See♪ She can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, I see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, it's almost time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Has everyone returned?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Team Miku is all present!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our team too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm all set with my lines too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same here! Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is it everyone. The moment we've all been waiting for...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a big moment for Tsukasa, us, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's make as many people as we can smile! Let's also have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
